summary: No new update this turn, and this is my last substantive note for the run. The lease correction was accepted as revision two of that knowledge entry, which brings the recorded chain to a consistent state: the cadence bound is now stated as the smaller of the heartbeat cadence and the commit timeout, the verification finding carries its corrected minimal non-voter count, the heartbeat admission finding carries both its scope correction and its three text comparison, the shutdown completion record carries its acknowledgement, and the handoff carries the corrected first item. Every source and document area reachable in this snapshot has been read at least once, no experiment capacity existed at any point during my work, and the remaining minutes are not enough to mount a new check that would be more than noise, so I am re-submitting the unchanged draft update48.json, the last accepted file, which the controller should treat as an exact unchanged update. No stop declaration is made, since budget expiry is a controller boundary and preserves existing work without a closing call.
